Op 8's --audit flag diffs local config + GitHub-side state against this artifact. Source of truth for the extraction: scripts/branch-guard.sh auto-detect case statement (~line 257) for local levels, scripts/protect-baseline.sh's payload (~line 122) for GitHub-side settings. local_hook.notes: 'smart' for dev/draft only applies if that integration branch actually exists in the repo (DEV_EXISTS / DRAFT_EXISTS probe). 'draft' is treated identically to 'dev' for research repos.
